stem.text: A constant resultant force acts on an object in the direction of the object's velocity.
Which graph could show the variation with time $t$ of the momentum $p$ of the object?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, with one curve drawn.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, with one curve drawn.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, with one straight line drawn.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis p and horizontal axis t, with one straight line drawn.
